children: OpenText and Cohere will partner to launch a joint agentic artificial intelligence solution for governments and regulated industries.

The data management company has agreed to form a strategic partnership with Cohere, a sovereign AI company, where OpenText will provide the underlying data, governance and context layer, while Cohere provides the application and orchestration layer through its agentic AI platform called North.

OpenText's target clients--which span federal governments, healthcare systems and financial institutions--will have access to Cohere-supported solutions both on-premises and through OpenText Cloud, the companies said Wednesday.
OpenText will integrate Cohere's models into its own Aviator AI agents.
The companies have set a timeline of early 2027 for the joint agentic solution.
